Level 0 - Prelims Round (Online Submission)
-------------------------------------------

This round is your opportunity to demonstrate your skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities. Top-performing teams will advance to the Level 1 Final Round. where you will final develop and demonstrate

Prelims Submission Checklist (Online Scrutiny)

Your submission will be evaluated based on Innovation, Technical Approach, Feasibility, Social Impact, and Research.

*   **Deadline:** 12th April 2026
*   **Platform:** Submit online via link shared on Team Lead email ID

### 1\. PowerPoint Presentation (PPT)

*   **Title Slide:** Project name, Team name, Team ID, Team Lead, College Name, Problem ID, Members, Mentor Name.
*   **Proposed Solution:** Innovation and uniqueness of the solution, Depth of the Detailed explanation of the proposed solution, Effectiveness of addressing the problem.
*   **Tech Approach:** Methodology, Process for implementation, Technologies to be used.
*   **Feasibility:** Feasibility analysis, Potential challenges, Strategies to overcome challenges.
*   **Impact on society:** Clear demonstration of the potential benefits and positive impact of the solution on society and SDGs.
*   **Research and References:** Links / Details of the reference and research work (Quality of datasets, APIs, and literature cited) .
*   **File Name:** TeamID\_PSID.ppt
*   **PPT Format:** [LINK](https://newhorizonindia.edu/smarthorizon/Smart-Horizon-2026-48Hour-Intrnl-Hack.pptx)
    

### 2\. Video Submission

*   **Length:** Usually 2–3 minutes.
*   **Content:**
    *   Brief intro of team and project.
    *   Problem and solution explained clearly
    *   Demo or walkthrough of your prototype(if any)
    *   Highlight innovation and impact
*   **Format:** MP4 (below 100MB).
*   **Tone:** Clear, confident, and engaging.
*   **File Name:** TeamID\_PSCode.mp4

Experts will evaluate submitted ideas, and teams that are chosen will receive a confirmation email by April 30, 2026, inviting them to develop and present their ideas at the final event.

Note:-

*   For Level 0 registration link, PPT format, guidelines, rules and regulations please visit our hackathon website: [https://newhorizonindia.edu/smarthorizon/](https://newhorizonindia.edu/smarthorizon/)
    
*   Do not disclose your personal details like Mobile No., E-mail ID etc. in PPT and Video
*   A team will be selected for one Problem Statement only.
*   The jury's decision will be final, regarding the selection of teams for the final round.

  
  

Level 1: Registration & Pre-Event Prep
--------------------------------------

| Date | Activity | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **16th February 2026** | Registration Opens (Online) | Online form, eligibility criteria, team size, and themes announced. |
| **9th March – 12th April 2026** | Prelims Round (Online Submission) | Idea submission based on selected themes. |
| **15th April – 25th April 2026** | Screening of Solutions (Online) | Idea screening and evaluation by the jury. |
| **30th April 2026** | Finalist Announcement (Online) | Finalists notified; detailed event schedule shared. |
| **1st May – 9th May 2026** | Finalist Team Registration (Online) | Online form and final confirmation for selected teams. |
| **22nd August 2026** | Pre-event Briefing (Online) | Briefing session for all finalist teams. |
| **3rd – 5th September 2026** | **Grand Finale (Offline)** | NHCE campus, Bangalore, Karnataka, India. |
